card.name: Start of a range before 'to'
card.fires_on: The first number or time unit of a range, just before the word 'to' (e.g. 'days to weeks', '0 to 16'). Mostly time-to-onset ranges in label text.

modes.label: Onset time ranges
modes.description: A time unit such as 'day' or 'days' that opens a range of onset times, right before 'to'.
modes.example: serious rash occurred 1<< day>> to 2 months after initiation of treatment

modes.label: Numeric value ranges
modes.description: The lower number of a numeric range, such as a score or dose range.
modes.example: the value can range from <<0>> to 16.

card.writes: It promotes 'up' and 'to'-type tokens (including Chinese 到 and 至), so it pushes the model toward the 'to' that ends the range's first half.
card.plain: It marks the first half of a 'from X to Y' range, especially for how soon after starting a drug a reaction appeared.
